country.evidence_quote: Jenteh Junior College of Medicine, Nursing and Management is located in Miaoli County, Taiwan, Republic of China. Jenteh, founded in 1967 as a senior vocational pharmaceutical school, was upgraded to Jenteh Junior College in 1999. The current president is Dr. Ming Hsueh Tsai.
